proposed_skill_yaml:
skill: peg_channel
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: approach_above
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.1
  weight: 0.3
- id: align_lateral
  anchor: object
  weight: 0.3
- id: push_channel
  metric: goal_progress
  weight: 0.4
phases:
- id: approach_peg
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    entity: peg
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.1
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  subtask_id: approach_above
- id: align_peg
  type: align
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    entity: peg
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    lateral_offset_x:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.01
      - 0.01
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.x
        mode: add
  retries:
    max_attempts: 0
    strategy: repeat
  subtask_id: align_lateral
- id: push_channel
  type: push
  generator: impedance_motion
  control: impedance_control
  termination: force_exceeded
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    entity: goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.16
      axis: task_goal_direction
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: positive
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    force_threshold:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 10.0
      - 40.0
      default: 30.0
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.force_threshold
        mode: replace
    lateral_retry_x:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.005
      - 0.005
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: retry.offset.x
        mode: add
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.2
      default: 0.16
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: force_ok
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    args:
      threshold: 40.0
    threshold: 40.0
    on_failure: abort
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: push_channel
- id: retract_up
  type: retract
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current

skill: peg_channel
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_contact
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0

  - 0.04
  weight: 0.2
- id: push_to_goal
  target_entity: object
  metric: goal_progress
  weight: 0.8
phases:
- id: approach
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.02
    - 0.04
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.5
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  retries:
    max_attempts: 0
    strategy: repeat
  subtask_id: reach_contact
- id: push
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: time_limit
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.1
    - 0.0
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    push_offset_y:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.15
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.y
        mode: replace
    push_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.2
      default: 0.08
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    push_timeout:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 2.0
      - 10.0
      default: 6.0
      binds_to:
      - path: duration.max_time
        mode: replace

    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 40.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.003
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: push_to_goal
